messages:
Lina: quick heads-up — Aurion bench sync. we promised a joint perf/W + throughput sweep for marketplace listing. want to align on acceptance criteria, tooling, and announcement cadence. @Jade can you confirm what telemetry hooks you can expose?
Samir: thanks. for acceptance i'd propose: 1) 95th p50 latency within X ms at target qps, 2) sustained perf/W > Y for 2hr run, 3) no correctness regressions on our prompt set. we should define exact numbers.
Jade (Aurion): we can expose power rails + PCIe power sensor. thermal telemetry available from BMC; can also enable host-side PM counters. we might need a short firmware tweak to report per-slice power. is that ok?
Lina: sounds good. firmware tweak timeline? we need to keep to the marketplace listing window (target week after next).
Jade (Aurion): firmware tweak is 5 business days to QA. can fast-track if we scope to just the sensor export (no behavioral changes).
Samir: ok lets plan two-phase run: phase A = current sensors (baseline) for quick turn, phase B = enhanced per-slice power (after fw). phase A should still be useful for perf/W delta. can you provide the sensor schema?
Jade (Aurion): attaching schema in a follow-up convo but quick summary: {rail_total_w, gpu_die_w, host_12v_w, bmc_temp_c}. includes timestamps at 1s granularity.
Lina: perfect. ops question — who will run the sweep? Redwood bench infra or Aurion lab?
Trevor: product note — marketing wants a coordinated announcement: we need a joint quote and a one-paragraph marketplace blurb. timeline depends on when phase A data lands. earliest announcement earliest 3 business days after phase A validation.
Samir: workload plan: longtail chat gen + batched throughput (seq=512) + embedding-only microbench. will run each workload for 30m steady-state, collect KV cache metrics, and run a 2hr stability perf/W test. quick snippet of the harness command: 
```
./run_bench --model rdx-13b-quant --seq 512 --qps 200 --duration 1800 --telemetry-out /tmp/aurion_phaseA.json
```
Lina: @Jade can Aurion side attach an external power meter reading so we have an independent perf/W validation?
Jade (Aurion): yes we have a Yokogawa inline meter. we can time-sync via NTP and provide meter logs. one ask: will you need raw per-token timing or aggregated buckets?
Samir: aggregated buckets (1s) plus occasional raw samples on anomalies. also include per-request model-token counts.
Lina: infra-wise — Samir will provision a dedicated runway in our Dedicated cluster (reserved GPU pool) to minimize noisy neighbors. Samir, can you confirm instance spec?
Samir: reserving 4x A800-equivalent nodes, pinned to same kernel and driver versions as Aurion lab. will post exact AMI/container.
Trevor: marketing asks: can we aim for a joint webinar 2 weeks from now if phase A is green and phase B finishes? also need compliance signoff for quoting numbers.
Lina: note: compliance needs the raw dataset and eval scripts to audit metric claims. Samir please include eval scripts in the artifact.
Samir: will do. CI plan: bench-bot will kick an automated run on merge and post a short summary. bench-bot: please run a smoke with minimal params and return pass/fail.
bench-bot: scheduled smoke run queued. will post results to thread once complete. :robot_face:
Jade (Aurion): small gotcha — our latest SOC driver has a kernel parameter that affects power gating. for phase A we can use default, for phase B we want power-gating off to measure worst-case perf/W, and then on for a tuned curve. will that break your baseline?
Samir: we should capture both. include a named config: "pg_on" and "pg_off" in the run metadata so we can compare. add it to the harness config.
Lina: outstanding action items: 1) Jade: provide sensor schema + meter hookup plan (by EOD tomorrow). 2) Samir: post AMI/container and harness config + eval scripts (by day after tomorrow). 3) Trevor: draft joint announcement skeleton (start of next week). 4) bench-bot: run smoke and report. we'll reconvene after phase A results. :thumbsup:
Jade (Aurion): ack. will also list thermal headroom limits and sustained power caps in the doc.
Samir: putting the run matrix here quick (will expand in GH): workloads=[chat_longtail, batched_throughput, embed_micro]; durations=[1800,1800,1200]; power_modes=[pg_on, pg_off]; telemetry=[sensor, meter, host_counters].
Lina: nice. last Q — any legal/partner ops forms needed before we publish numbers? Trevor?
Trevor: partner ops needs a short data-sharing addendum signed. i'll loop in legal. shouldn't block phase A telemetry but required before public announcement.
Lina: great — thanks all. I'll create a short GH issue linking artifacts and set a meeting for the results review.
bench-bot: smoke run complete: phaseA minimal harness OK, telemetry endpoints reachable, no crashes. summary: 3 tests passed. Logs: https://redwood.internal/bench/1778234567/smoke
Samir: awesome, starting provisioning now.
Jade (Aurion): we'll stand by for meter sync and firmware scope.
Trevor: i'll draft the quote template and share in #partnerships-drafts.
Lina: closing the loop — target checkpoint check-in Friday 10am PT. thanks everyone. :rocket:
